key_findings: Work hour speedup: 70.9x faster (6,024.5 hours vs 85 hours)
Calendar time speedup: 150.6x faster (753 days vs 5 days)
AI's 24/7/365 advantage: Additional 2.1x speedup from round-the-clock operation
AI + Native Polish is 95.4-97.7% cheaper than human-only ($10,600-21,000 vs $459,500)
Actual cost: $200/month Claude Pro subscription + $10,400-20,800 native polish
8 concurrent AI agents achieved 6.1x speedup with 76% efficiency
AI achieves 100% technical compliance but requires 2-4 weeks native speaker polish
ROI of 4,613x on AI subscription investment (or infinite if already subscribing)
Marginal cost: $0 for AI if already subscribing to Claude Pro for other work
24/7 cost advantage: 6,888x cheaper than human 3-shift coverage ($200 vs $1.38M)
AI can work nights, weekends, holidays with no overtime, no premium pay
Impossible deadlines become possible: 2+ year project compressed to 1 week
Larger projects see even greater ROI due to framework reusability
AI excels at systematic tasks, struggles with native linguistic intuition
Optimal strategy: AI for creation + Human for native polish
Quality trade-off: 92-95% AI-only vs 98-99% after polish

recommendations.future_outlook: As AI linguistic capabilities improve, the 'native speaker polish' gap will narrow. Current 70.9x speedup may increase to 100-200x within 2-3 years.

conclusion.primary: AI-assisted literary creation achieves 70.9x speedup and 95.4-97.7% cost reduction while maintaining technical perfection, at the cost of requiring 2-4 weeks native speaker polish for publication quality with current general-purpose models.
conclusion.strategic: Paradigm shift in creative production: moves literary creation toward systematic engineering, enables individual creators to execute large-scale projects, redefines timeline expectations (months → days).
conclusion.economic: Transformatively cost-effective with ROI of 4,613x, enabling projects previously economically infeasible. If already subscribing: infinite ROI (marginal cost = $0).
conclusion.quality: Technically perfect with general models, linguistically needs polish. AI excels at rules, needs help with native intuition. Fine-tuned models could close this gap.
conclusion.future: Lower bound on AI capability with general-purpose model (Claude Sonnet 4.5). Within 1-2 years, fine-tuned models could reduce polish 75%. Within 2-3 years, specialized models could achieve 98-99% quality directly. Speedup could increase from 70.9x to 100-200x.
